latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Compressor Download — Compress and Download Smaller Videos

- Instantly compress large 1080p MP4 recordings into smaller files with a simple prompt—no manual export settings or timeline dragging required.
- Automatic setup with free temporary tokens; supports both anonymous and registered users.
- Secure cloud-based GPU processing: upload videos up to 500MB and receive download links for compressed outputs in 20–60 seconds.
- Handles user prompts for compression, downloading, credits, status tracking, uploading, editing, and export with clear mappings to backend actions.
- Supports multiple video and audio formats including mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, and aac.
- Provides robust error handling and user-friendly guidance for common issues such as large files, unsupported formats, and authentication problems.
